name: Blood Royal
source: A perverted pirate sails the seven seas, armed with a torture chamber and his depraved imagination. Nothing is off limits in this bizarre excursion into a world of erotic peril. Two Princesses try to run away from their homelands only to end up in his hands. This is a story about how these two persevere and get through this torture.
translation: 一个变态的海盗带着刑讯室和他邪恶的想象力在七大洋中航行。在这个充满色情危险的世界的奇异之旅中，没有任何限制。两位公主试图逃离家园，结果却落入了他的手中。这是一个关于两人如何坚持并度过这场折磨的故事。
